name: Sprout Social
summary: Sprout Social began notifying about 260 people, 20% of its staff, on 15 July 2026, under a plan its board approved on 8 July.

facts.label: People affected
facts.detail: Disclosed in the company's own filing with the SEC on the day notifications began.

facts.label: Set aside for severance and benefits
facts.detail: The company's estimate of restructuring charges, which it says consist primarily of cash severance payments and benefits, to be recognised in the third quarter of 2026.

facts.label: Expected to complete
facts.figure: by the end of the third quarter of 2026
